create.name: Lindsay Mack
create.bio:
Lindsay Mack is a tarot teacher, writer and podcast host based in Portland, Oregon, who started Tarot for the Wild Soul. They have worked with the cards for more than thirty years and professionally for over a decade, developing a method they call Soul Tarot. In this approach no card is treated as bad or as a fixed prediction; each one is read as an invitation and a companion for the present moment, and students are encouraged to bring their whole, unpolished selves to the deck. Lindsay is also a trained death doula and sings with a local threshold choir.

Most of the teaching happens online through Soul Tarot School: a monthly membership with live Zoom workshops and a private podcast, a weekend foundations immersion for newer readers, and an eight-week practitioner training for those who want to read for others. They also give one-to-one readings, lead residential retreats in North America, and write the No Bad Cards newsletter. The long-running Tarot for the Wild Soul podcast offers monthly card guidance and answers listener questions. In 2026 Running Press published Lindsay's debut book, Tarot for the Wild Soul, together with the companion Soul Tarot deck illustrated by Chelsea Granger.

books.title: Tarot for the Wild Soul
books.author: Lindsay Mack
books.description: Lindsay's first book sets out the Soul Tarot method card by card, reading each one as an ally for the present rather than a forecast. It includes practices for setting an intention before a reading and a selection of spreads, and suits both beginners and experienced readers.

books.title: Soul Tarot: A Deck and Guidebook for Healing and Self-Discovery
books.author: Lindsay Mack, Chelsea Granger
books.description: A 78-card deck with artwork by Chelsea Granger and a guidebook by Lindsay, designed to sit alongside the Tarot for the Wild Soul book. The cards are designed to be used as present-moment anchors and supportive allies rather than tools for prediction.

courses.title: The Soul Tarot Membership
courses.description: A monthly membership with two live tarot workshops on Zoom each month, a private podcast feed of classes and Q&As, and a community space for practising with other readers. Suited to beginner and intermediate readers who want to go deeper at their own pace.

courses.title: Soul Tarot Foundations
courses.description: A live three-day weekend on Zoom covering every card of the deck, reversals included, with time to practise and ask questions. Offered twice a year for newer and intermediate readers, with recordings for anyone who cannot attend live.

courses.title: The Soul Tarot Practitioner Training
courses.description: An eight-week live training over Zoom, run twice a year, for people who want to read tarot for clients or deepen their skills considerably. It covers holding space for others, handling difficult readings and, for those who wish, starting to read professionally.

courses.title: Soul Tarot Readings & Sessions with Lindsay
courses.description: One-to-one sessions with Lindsay by phone or audio-only Zoom: a 60-minute Soul Tarot reading, or a 60-minute intuitive support session for people who feel out of touch with their own intuition. A photo of the spread and a recording follow afterwards.

free_resources.title: Tarot Tending
free_resources.description: A recorded free workshop on using a tarot deck as steady support through uncertain or difficult times. Available in exchange for joining the mailing list.

free_resources.title: The Ultimate Soul Tarot Card Guide
free_resources.description: A free downloadable guide to the cards from the Soul Tarot point of view, meant to help readers trust what they pull. Sent by email after sign-up.

free_resources.title: Tarot for the Wild Soul podcast
free_resources.description: Lindsay's long-running free podcast, mixing monthly card guidance, lessons on individual cards and answers to listener questions. Episodes and transcripts are listed on the site.
